title: hieracium caesium subsp. varianum
intro: Hieracium caesium subsp. varianum, commonly known as common cornflower or white cornflower, is a plant species in the dandelion family, characterized by its white or pale blue flowers. This plant is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium caesium subsp. varianum include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
